question: Does AWS Device Farm currently grant the 1,000 device-minute trial or the standard 250 minutes, and is a private-device or unmetered-slot purchase still open to new accounts?
why: The pricing page calls 1,000 minutes a limited-time trial in place of the standard 250, and slot purchases need account approval; only an account can settle which allocation applies.
